messages:
maya (eng-release): kicking off a gradual feature-flag toggle for traffic-signal-v2 now — goal: 0 -> 50% over 30m if health looks good

sam (sre): thanks — what's the exact ramp schedule and rollback criteria?

maya (eng-release): plan: 0% -> 5% at t+5m, 5% -> 20% at t+12m, 20% -> 50% at t+30m. Canaries pinned to runtime v2.3.1.

lauren (prod): linking release notes: https://redwood.example.com/releases/2419876543 — includes perf notes and user-visible changes. Notify support after 50%

sam (sre): rollback triggers: >1.0% 5m error rate on 502/5xx OR p95 generation latency regression >250ms vs baseline OR increase in user-facing retries. If any trigger, pause and roll back to 0%.

maya (eng-release): added check: if deploy-bot reports >2% error in first 10m at any cohort, auto-pause and ping #oncall. Manual rollback if >2% sustained for 2x window.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: feature=traffic-signal-v2, cohorts=[canary0, canary1, ramp], target_version=runtime-v2.3.1, owner=@maya. Canary 1: 5% scheduled in 5m.

jin (infra): confirming we pinned the model variant for canary nodes — kernel selection locked to x86-cuda-ptx-optimized-3 to avoid perf jitter.

maya (eng-release): config snippet to apply (use safe toggle command):
```
redwood toggle set traffic-signal-v2 --cohort canary0 --percent 5 --pin runtime=v2.3.1
redwood toggle monitor traffic-signal-v2 --window 5m --metrics error_rate,p95_latency
```

sam (sre): +1 to the monitor command. Also run smoke tests against canary cohort after the first shift (healthcheck endpoint /_health).

lauren (prod): support notified: @support-team will be on standby at +1 if we hit 50%. I'll post canned message for customers if rollback happens.

maya (eng-release): canary shift now executed (5% to canary0). Watch logs: https://logs.redwood.example.com/streams/2419876543

deploy-bot: Canary cohort canary0 healthy: error_rate=0.12%, p95=180ms (baseline p95=170ms)

sam (sre): that's fine. proceed to next step at +7m.

maya (eng-release): bumping to 20% across canary0+canary1 now (scheduled)

deploy-bot: Ramp update: traffic-signal-v2 -> 20% applied. Monitoring windows active.

sam (sre): observed a small spike in 4xxs (client timeouts) for one shard, investigating. @jin can you check shard-03 network egress?

jin (infra): looking — saw transient overload on shard-03 egress, autoscale kicked but queue backed up ~30s. Bumping burst capacity and draining now.

maya (eng-release): decision: hold at 20% for 15m while infra stabilizes. Not advancing to 50% until shard-03 is green.

lauren (prod): agreed. notifying support and productops.

sam (sre): monitors back to normal after drain. No 5xx spike. If stable for 15m, we can proceed to 50%.

maya (eng-release): proceeding to 50% in 3m if no regressions.

deploy-bot: Final ramp: traffic-signal-v2 -> 50% applied. Canary pin runtime-v2.3.1 held.

tom (pm): nice — marking rollout complete in release notes. Please add any post-deploy observability notes to the ticket.

maya (eng-release): will update the ticket with metrics and the toggle state. If anyone sees oddness, ping me directly. :rocket:
